decisions.statement: A play of no length runs no minutes.
Minutes are counted to three places.
The ESO day a play lands on is worked out from when the play finished.
A title key drops every character that is no lowercase letter and no digit.
A title key an artist is unknown for is the track name alone.
A priming run scores no first listen.
A resume cursor is one millisecond past the newest play already filed.
A newest play that will not parse leaves the cursor unset.

definition: the arithmetic turning one play of a track into the row that play is filed as
